units.text: Jaeden Mustaf — all-state at Carmel, led the 2022–23 team to 28–4 and the state final, and the son of ex-NBA player Jerrod Mustaf. Georgia Tech → Indiana (April 2026). He transferred in from DeMatha; whether he graduated from Carmel is unconfirmed.

units.text: This card is deliberately short. Gaston Day publishes no venue list, and the one document that would carry it (the Athletic Handbook) is not reachable. That is a publication gap, not an absence of facilities — a campus fielding 19 sports plainly has them.

Each row is the college the athlete went to out of Hickory Grove, as listed on that college’s own roster. P4 = SEC · Big Ten · ACC · Big 12. Colby Vanhook’s junior college is listed at the D3 tier for want of an NJCAA level in this table’s scale.
